## Description

Load profile for two clinics plus headroom (e.g. 20 concurrent receptionists, 200 bookings/hour, board subscriptions). Measure booking API p95, search p95, board load, calendar first render on throttled 4G. Add the budgets to CI (nightly) with alerts on regression.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Booking API p95 < 300 ms and reads p95 < 300 ms / writes < 600 ms under the profile on staging.
- [ ] **AC2.** Calendar first render < 2.5 s on a typical clinic PC profile over 4G throttling.
- [ ] **AC3.** Nightly performance job fails and alerts on > 20 % regression.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
